title: Best quote
description: The tightest bid and ask on this venue's BTC book. The gap between them is what it costs to trade immediately.

bid.label: Bid
bid.description: The highest price a buyer is waiting at on this venue. Selling into the venue fills here.

ask.label: Ask
ask.description: The lowest price a seller is waiting at on this venue. Buying from the venue fills here.

midpoint.label: Midpoint
midpoint.description: Halfway between the bid and the ask, the venue's fair price for BTC right now. Most other signals on this venue are built from it.

spread_bps.label: Spread
spread_bps.description: The gap between bid and ask as a share of the midpoint, in basis points. Wide means thin liquidity and expensive fills.
